The '''Battle of Malrev IV''' was one of the opening battles of the [[Light and Darkness War]], in [[1004 BBY]]. In a similar way to the [[Battle of Dromund Kaas (New Sith Wars)|Battle of Dromund Kaas]] that took place around the same time, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] landed an army to occupy the planet but they were repelled by a violent [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] counterattack.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Boc Aseca]] would later [[Psychometry/Legends|relive]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] victory via impressions taken from the ashes of ancient Jedi [[Newar Forrth]], another Twi'lek.<ref name="Dark Forces 4">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050526a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 4: Of the Crudest Matter}}</ref>
